reason: This text from Exodus describes the plagues of Egypt, which Yahweh sends against Pharaoh and Egypt specifically because Pharaoh refuses to permit the Israelites to worship Yahweh in the wilderness. The Israelites actively request permission to go worship ("let my people go, that they may celebrate to me in the wilderness" and "we will sacrifice to Yahweh our God"), but are prevented by Pharaoh from doing so. The plagues are directed at Pharaoh and the Egyptians as coercion to allow proper worship, not at the Israelites for worshiping improperly. The issue is obstruction of worship, not improper worship itself.
